goal.objective: Finish the ChatGPT connector and CPU/RAM monitor implementation and make them actually work in this chat. Wire the tested Effect-native cancellation path and the client permission refresh into loadable plugin entries, keep image output disabled until its rename race is fixed, run all relevant checks, activate the plugins additively without disturbing existing settings, and demonstrate real operation: numeric CPU/RAM readings and a real ChatGPT-backed tool response. Never modify the OpenCode binary; plugin/MCP only.
goal.completionEvidence: Live acceptance in this session on 2026-10-29: tools.chatgpt_direct.chat({prompt:"Reply with exactly: connector online"}) returned "connector online" through the user's active OpenAI OAuth connection, and tools.chatgpt_direct.web_search returned real Codex search results with sources. The namespace is exposed to this chat, so the plugin loaded. Cause of the earlier failures was diagnosed from service logs (HTTP 400 model_not_found for catalog Codex names); resolution now retries the account-reported Codex model list, aborts on interruption, and logs bounded error detail locally. Plugin-only: no OpenCode binary, core, or MCP-process changes. Activation was additive to /home/james/.opencode-v2-pilot/config/opencode.jsonc (server plugin) and cli.json (TUI monitor); both files were backed up first and existing goal, goal-docs, voice-assistant, lmstudio-preload and strata entries are preserved. TUI reconciliation logs 19 plugins with no failure. Monitor: 24/24 tests pass including a real /proc sample of a live process and the non-leader-thread regression; connector: 73 pass, 1 known image-rename-race test skipped; typechecks pass against pinned and installed 2.1.1 declarations. Cancellation and prompt-refresh paths are fake-backed tested, not live-cancelled; image output remains unregistered.
